notes.key_messages: Candidates should read the questions carefully, identify what is being asked and eliminate any data which is not relevant. Candidates need to review their understanding of the double entries in a suspense account to correct errors and the calculation of return on capital employed (ROCE). notes.general_comments: General comments There were only four questions where more than 70 per cent of candidates identified the correct option: 1, 2, 4 and 25. There were three questions which merit some discussion. These will be reviewed in the next Comments on specific questions Using suspense accounts always seems to cause problems. Looking at the data, to correct the bank account there would need to be a debit entry of $28 142 to cancel the error and a further debit entry of $28 412 to ensure the correct balance was entered. The undercast of $450 would also need a debit entry. Thus the suspense account would need to be credited with the total of these three items, $57 004, being the key C.
